text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks) has 
arrived. They even broadcasted a flashy 
special video featuring me as the star, so 
my excitement is through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides, having a completely different 
style from past footage proves I'm a cut 
above as a heroine! I will ab-so-lutely 
become the Queen of the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, both the little girl who 
wants to become a princess and the mean 
boy came to cheer, leaving her deeply 
moved!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could the day I become a Pre-Fi be just 
around the corner?! My Princess☆Vital 
Strike was fiercely on fire!
